title: Bootshaus & Loonyland pres. NYE 2026
sourceDescription:
Ring in the new year at Bootshaus.

On December 31st, we open all floors for our annual New Year’s Eve celebration, taking you from the final hours of 2026 straight into the first morning of 2027.

Expect a full-club experience across Mainfloor, Blckbx, and Dreherei, with carefully curated lineups, extended sets, and the signature Bootshaus atmosphere all night long.
